description: A startup script for PostgreSQL that handles initialization, startup, and configuration of database, user, permissions, and environment variables.

methods.name: Main script logic
methods.description: Handles the overall process of checking PostgreSQL status, initializing database if needed, starting the server, configuring permissions, and saving environment setup files.

methods.name: Setup connection info
methods.description: Creates and writes connection string to 'db_connection.txt' and environment variables to 'db_visualizer/postgres.env'.
